The '''Wind Spire''' is a [[Weapons#Dagger|dagger weapon]] that can be obtained by [[The Mines#Crates and Barrels|breaking boxes and barrels]], or as a [[The Mines#Special Items|special monster drop]], on floors 20-39 in [[The Mines]]. It is a possible reward for the chest on floor 10 of the Mines if "remixed" mine rewards are selected in the [[Options|Advanced Options]] menu when starting a new game.

==History==
